description: Collect Amazon customer reviews plus each product's rating summary with no login or proxy setup. Add product URLs/ASINs or discover products by keyword; reviews are merged and deduplicated, with optional extended history and filters.

categoryUrls.description: Advanced discovery: Amazon `/s?...` search URLs or `/b?node=...` category URLs. Used only when `productUrls` is empty.
categoryUrls.title: Category or Search URLs (discover products)

cookieString.description: Optional. Paste your own logged-in Amazon session cookie (the literal Cookie header value) to use paginated /product-reviews/ and unlock deeper history. Never required; the actor returns real public data without it. Never paste a password.
cookieString.title: Amazon Session Cookie (optional)

country.description: Amazon storefront to use for bare ASINs, discovery, and products whose URL does not carry a domain. Product URLs keep their own domain.
country.title: Amazon Marketplace

extendedHistory.description: Merge Amazon's public extended review feed for each ASIN (no login): up to 100 rows per star/sort bucket, typically 100-800+ unique reviews for popular US products, deduplicated against the product-page sample. Coverage varies by ASIN and the feed carries Amazon.com reviews only.
extendedHistory.title: Extended Review History

filterByStar.description: Keep only reviews with this rating. `positive` keeps 4-5 stars and `critical` keeps 1-2 stars. Applied after merging, so narrow filters can legitimately return few or no rows.
filterByStar.title: Filter by Star Rating

filterKeywords.description: Keep only reviews whose title or text contains at least one of these keywords (case-insensitive). Empty = no keyword filter.
filterKeywords.title: Filter by Keywords

includeAggregates.description: Emit one `amazon_review_aggregate` record per product with product title, average rating, global ratings count, star histogram, derived per-star counts, and Amazon's "Customers say" summary with aspects. The histogram is filled from the rating-summary popover when the page omits it.
includeAggregates.title: Include Rating Summary

includeGdprSensitive.description: Include reviewer display name, profile link, and avatar. Leave off for GDPR-sensitive workloads.
includeGdprSensitive.title: Include Reviewer Names and Profiles

includeImages.description: Extract full-resolution image and video URLs uploaded by reviewers.
includeImages.sectionDescription: Toggle optional fields. GDPR-sensitive reviewer identity is off by default.
includeImages.title: Include Review Images and Videos

keywords.description: Search terms used to discover products when `productUrls` is empty (e.g. "wireless earbuds"). Each keyword contributes up to `maxProductsToDiscover` products.
keywords.title: Keywords (discover products)

maxProductsToDiscover.description: Maximum products discovered from each keyword or category URL (1-50). Ignored when `productUrls` is supplied.
maxProductsToDiscover.title: Max Products to Discover

maxReviews.description: Hard cap per product after merging and deduplication (1-2000). The product-page sample alone yields about 8-13 rows; the optional extended feed can add 100-800+ for popular US products. In optional cookie mode this is the paginated cap.
maxReviews.sectionDescription: Control review depth and which public sources are merged.
maxReviews.title: Max Reviews per Product

mediaReviewsOnly.description: Keep only reviews that include at least one reviewer-uploaded image or video.
mediaReviewsOnly.title: Media Reviews Only

mergeMarketplaces.description: Fetch the same product on these additional Amazon marketplaces and merge their deduplicated product-page reviews. Empty = the product's own marketplace only.
mergeMarketplaces.title: Merge Extra Marketplaces

productUrls.description: Amazon product URLs (/dp/, /gp/product/, /gp/aw/d/, /product/) or bare 10-character ASINs, on any supported Amazon domain. Leave empty to discover products from `keywords`/`categoryUrls` instead.
productUrls.sectionDescription: Scrape these products, or leave empty and discover products by keyword or category.
productUrls.title: Product URLs or ASINs

reviewsNewerThan.description: Keep only reviews dated on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or any ISO date). Reviews whose localized date cannot be parsed are kept. Empty = no date filter.
reviewsNewerThan.title: Reviews Newer Than

sortBy.description: Order of the returned reviews: most helpful first, or most recent first.
sortBy.title: Sort Reviews By

verifiedPurchasesOnly.description: Keep only reviews carrying Amazon's Verified Purchase badge. Applied server-side in the extended feed (and cookie mode) and client-side for product-page rows.
verifiedPurchasesOnly.title: Verified Purchases Only

title: Amazon Customer Review & Rating Summary Scraper Input
